title: The 5 Best Mini Fridges for Bedrooms
h1: The 5 Best Mini Fridges for Bedrooms
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for mini fridges for bedrooms, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini fridges for bedrooms using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Midea WHS-160RB1 4.4 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.4 cu ft capacity, 42 dB rated noise level, Reversible door with adjustable legs.
strengths: 42 dB rating is quiet enough for most people to sleep through the compressor cycling
4.4 cu ft is roomy enough for a full stock of drinks and late-night snacks
Adjustable legs help level it on carpet
limitations: 33.86-inch height is bulkier than a typical bedroom nightstand fridge
No true freezer, chiller compartment only
Larger footprint takes noticeable floor or dresser-top space
features: Small chiller compartment, not a true freezer

products.name: Frigidaire EFR176 1.6 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.6 cu ft capacity, 18.5-inch height, Retro-styled body with a side-mounted bottle opener.
strengths: 18.5-inch height fits comfortably on a dresser top or low nightstand shelf
Retro color options double as bedroom decor rather than an obvious appliance
Flush back allows placement directly against a wall
limitations: 1.6 cu ft is small -- drinks and snacks only
Runs slightly louder than the Midea at full cooling cycle per owner reports
Plastic door handle feels less durable over years of use
features: Retro-styled body with a side-mounted bottle opener

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BCRK25V 2.5 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.5 cu ft single-door capacity, ENERGY STAR certified, about 212 kWh/year, Small freezer compartment with ice tray.
strengths: 2.5 cu ft is a comfortable middle ground between capacity and footprint
Glass shelves fit tall bottles and medication storage boxes
limitations: Small top freezer barely holds an ice tray
Not rated as quiet as the Midea, though most owners don't find it disruptive
features: Small freezer compartment with ice tray

products.name: Galanz GLR31TBEER 3.1 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer, True dual-door design with an actual freezer, Adjustable mechanical thermostat.
strengths: Retro styling reads as bedroom furniture, not a dorm appliance
Under-42 dB compressor keeps overnight noise low
Only fridge in this list with a genuine separate freezer for a bedroom setup
limitations: Taller and heavier than a typical bedroom-only fridge
Pricier than the single-door options in this list
Plastic interior parts feel less sturdy than metal shelving on pricier fridges
features: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer
True dual-door design with an actual freezer

products.name: Midea WHS-65LB1 1.6 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
limitations: Can over-chill items near the top

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
